sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Melchio is one of the Six Armors, who later can be summoned as a Unit. Soon after its arrival in Lizeria, it laid waste to the nearest village, which made Michele departed to defeat it. Its mission is to destroy the worlds for a certain reason.

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content:
After Melchio destroyed the nearest village, Lodin found it and they engaged in a battle.

If we follow the route where Lodin won, Lodin will be overjoyed, and Melchio will relocate to the other world.

If we follow the route where Lodin lost, Lodin then tell Michele about how strong Melchio is, and he will either joined Michele's party or not, depending on which ending you aim.

sections.title: In the storyline
sections.content:
Melchio was the fifth of the installment called Six Armors, made by Reis. After its activation, Melchio soon believed that its master had been abandoned by the world. Melchio then classified the worlds as its enemy, and thus, must be destroyed. Melchio then destroyed its master's homeworld, and sucked into the portal to Grand Gaia, along with the other three armors.

Melchio then landed in Lizeria, where it destroyed the nearest village soon after its arrival. This led Michele determined to chase Melchio and she departed on a journey together with Melchio's "sibling", Duel-GX.

After its destruction thanks to Duel-SGX's sacrifice, Melchio ceased to function, until its sudden revival after the people of Grand Gaia were eradicated by the gods.

sections.title: Personality
sections.content: As an armor, it seems that it devoted its life to protect its creator, which made it went into a rampage and destroy the worlds after it came into a conclusion that its creator had been abandoned by the world.

sections.title: Reis
sections.content: Reis was the creator of Melchio, as well as the rest of Six Armors. After seeing how Reis is absorbed by his research, Melchio concluded that the worlds has been abandoned Reis, and thus, must be eradicated.

sections.title: Duel-GX
sections.content: Duel-GX was another member of Six Armors just like Melchio. It was sent to stop Melchio from destroying the worlds.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- The lore of Dark Armor Reis contained an error where it stated that "Armor No. 5 was also destroyed". The original lore in Japanese actually said that "Armor No. 5 destroyed his homeworld".
- If Armor No. 5 was destroyed, then Melchio wouldn't arrive in Lizeria.
